title: Halloween collection: Afterlife
summary: Three pairs of animated 3D wings back from the other side - Cobweb, Bone Dragon and Wraith. In the Velo Store until November 7.

blocks.text: Halloween is here, and so is **Afterlife** - three new pairs of **3D wings** for the spookiest weeks of the year. Like every pair, they **move with you**: calm wingbeats while you stand, big strokes when you run or fly, spread wide while you glide.
**Limited time:** Afterlife is only in the Store until **November 7**. Whatever you get stays yours after that.

items: **Cobweb Wings** - tattered bat wings strung with cobwebs, their edges smouldering orange.
**Bone Dragon Wings** - the bare bones of a dragon's wings, claws tipped with a sickly green glow.
**Wraith Wings** - a wraith's shroud torn into wings, violet wisps that trail behind you.

blocks.caption: Afterlife in the in-game Store - the banner counts down the days it has left.
Try every pair on your own player, in every animation, before you buy.

blocks.text: Every pair has its own settings - **size**, **height**, **distance**, **spread**, **flap speed** and **flap strength** - and other Velo Client players see your wings exactly the way you set them up.
Afterlife wings are **Velo Coins** items, from **2,600 coins**. Open the **Store** in the launcher or from the pause menu.
